new_results.statement: If (S,T) has joint density cap M, the genuine S marginal has cap K, and independent V has cap 1, then S^2+2TV has density cap <=sqrt(2)(5+2log2)sqrt(MK)+sqrt(12)M^(3/4)K^(-1/4).

For Q=a(S+d)^2+2b(T+cS+alpha)(V+beta)+r with pair joint cap M, first marginal cap K, independent V cap L, the density cap is <=C1[LMK/(|ab|)]^(1/2)+C2(LM)^(3/4)K^(-1/4)|a|^(-1/4)|b|^(-3/4). The same uniform estimate survives arbitrary parameters measurable in an additional disjoint source bank.

For (S,T) an orthonormal 2D projection of one cap-one product bank and V a unit scalar projection of a disjoint product bank, ||p_(S^2+2TV)||_infinity<24.992 although S,T may be dependent; effective spectrum is exactly {-1,1,1}.

proof_mechanism: Exact nonlinear product kernel. Use joint cap only on small product coordinate, true first-marginal mass/cap on large product coordinate, then near/far integration across |q-s^2|. This avoids the invalid bounded-joint-density-alone indefinite coarea shortcut.
